title: Format {name}
label: Volume label
quickHint: Create a fresh filesystem without overwriting every sector.
fullHint: Overwrite the entire volume before creating the filesystem. This can take a long time.
forceHint: System volumes remain protected. Linux refuses to unmount a volume that is busy.
warning: Formatting permanently erases all files on this volume. This operation cannot be undone.
running: Formatting is running. Wait for it to finish before closing this window.

blocked.system_volume: The operating system or an essential system folder uses this volume. Formatting is blocked.
blocked.system_or_busy_volume: This is a system, reserved, recovery, paging or unsupported volume. Formatting is blocked.
blocked.active_swap: This device is active swap. Formatting is blocked.
blocked.no_media: There is no usable media in this device.
blocked.partitioned_disk: Choose a data partition. A disk containing partitions cannot be formatted as a single volume here.
blocked.managed_volume: This managed volume type cannot be formatted here.
blocked.in_use: This device has active holders or its state cannot be verified.
blocked.tools_missing: No supported filesystem formatter is installed on this host.
